sources.note: Reformulates chart question answering as a chain in which every reasoning step carries a predicted image region, trains that pairing through a curriculum graded by nesting depth, and finds explicit intermediate grounding worth 8.78 points over letting the model attend implicitly.
sources.title: CURV: Enhancing Chart Understanding Through Curriculum Visual Grounded Reasoning

sources.note: Splits a video model's latent computation into perception latents that always ground the question in visual evidence and reasoning latents allocated only when the question needs inference, and shows that reasoning latents without rationale supervision are worse than no reasoning latents at all.
sources.title: Perception Before Reasoning: Dynamic Latent Reasoning for Video Understanding and Question Answering

sources.note: Turns token-level teacher-student log-probability gaps into turn-level credit for agentic RL by recursively updating a Bayesian belief in log-odds space, identifying pivotal turns without a critic.
sources.title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

sources.note: Weights on-policy self-distillation supervision by how each local teacher-student divergence compares to the sequence mean, gating backward multi-step aggregation on that comparison.
sources.title: DASH: Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons for On-Policy Self-Distillation of Reasoning Models

sources.note: Concentrates privileged self-distillation on reasoning pivots identified by the teacher's distributional shift when an English reference solution is added or removed, for multilingual reasoning transfer.
sources.title: RP-OPSD: Reasoning-Pivot-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multilingual Reasoning Transfer

sources.note: Trains a multimodal agent to orchestrate twelve video-analysis tools for anomaly detection with GRPO under a dual reward that combines exact-match rule checks with an LLM judge scoring logicality, relevance and completeness, and releases the benchmark it is evaluated on.
sources.title: VTO: Visual Tool Orchestration for Video Anomaly Detection

sources.note: Gives a search agent an explicitly reversible trajectory tree with reflect and backtrack as first-class actions, and trains the reflection policy with a dense local signal distilled from a teacher that can see the whole trajectory alongside the sparse terminal reward the local decision is ultimately judged by.
sources.title: LoongReflect: Boosting Long-Horizon Reflection in Search Agents via Global Perspective Distillation

sources.note: Reallocates half of a test-time sampling budget from generating more solutions to asking the same model to refute a handful of decision-critical claims extracted from each trace, then weights the consensus vote by how many claims survive.
sources.title: Claim-Level Reliability Assessment for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning

sources.note: Improves factuality by reweighting reasoning segments according to state-transition probabilities along the thinking process, targeting a gap where correct facts appear in reasoning but not in the answer.
sources.title: MR-ALIGN: Meta-Reasoning Informed Factuality Alignment for Large Reasoning Models

sources.note: Edits the internal representation of a written scratchpad state while holding the printed text fixed, and asks whether the next step follows the transition rule applied to the edited value — turning 'does the model use its scratchpad?' into a causal test with a single correct answer.
sources.title: Do Models Read What They Write? Causal Registers in Scratchpad Reasoning

sources.note: Proves that parameterizing an outcome reward as the log-likelihood ratio between a policy and a reference model makes the per-step Q value fall out of the same model for free, so a process reward model can be obtained by training an outcome reward model on response-level labels alone.
sources.title: Free Process Rewards without Process Labels

sources.note: Formalizes 'spend test-time compute well' as a meta-reinforcement-learning problem — treating one long output stream as a sequence of episodes and scoring it by cumulative regret over tokens — and trains against a dense progress bonus that outcome-only reward cannot express.
sources.title: Optimizing Test-Time Compute via Meta Reinforcement Fine-Tuning

sources.note: Introduces EDIS, a trajectory-level score that measures how unstably token entropy evolves during generation, and uses it to select better reasoning rollouts at inference and to curate training samples in RL.
sources.title: EDIS: Diagnosing LLM Reasoning via Entropy Dynamics

sources.note: Proves via circuit complexity that bounded-depth Transformers cannot directly solve basic arithmetic, linear equations or general dynamic programming unless their size grows super-polynomially, while constant-size autoregressive Transformers can solve all of them by generating chain-of-thought derivations.
sources.title: Towards Revealing the Mystery behind Chain of Thought: A Theoretical Perspective

Name those. Leave the list empty rather than repeating what the sources already put side by side.

Rules:

output_schema.kind: string - one of: concept, method, dataset, model

result.definition: Supervising or verifying intermediate steps rather than only the final answer, across 14 sources both a method family and an assumption the archive questions. The assumption is that a written scratchpad exposes the intermediate variables that matter for later behaviour -- and the faithfulness literature says written reasoning can be incomplete, post-hoc, or driven by features it never mentions, so a step label may be scoring a description rather than a computation. The cost objection is the other standing one: step-level verification isolates errors precisely and is computationally exhaustive, usually requiring either annotation or a separately trained verifier. The archived methods respond by finding a cheaper source of step signal -- reusing labels that existing datasets already contain, deriving them from a frozen reference policy's likelihood of a gold answer, distilling them from a teacher that can see the whole trajectory, or computing them from the divergence between two context views of the same model. All of these buy density at the cost of measuring agreement with something rather than correctness, which is the trade the archive's process-reward entry records in detail.
